purpose: Six free hosted models from six model families on all twelve core-12 tasks at seeds 0 and 1, so the leaderboard can show whether the tasks tell models apart. Plus the four seed 1 tasks the first nemotron run's call ceiling cut short, which completes its second seed. Unsolved runs are read by a judge from a family none of the six belongs to, the first time the three judged failure modes and context drift are measured.

models.note: Completes seed 1. The first run's shared ceiling of 500 calls ran out before these four started, so they were never attempted.
